purpose: Our client launches a new SGLT2 inhibitor. We want to focus our physician advertising campaign on the regions where these drugs are already prescribed most.
question: How many patients have an active SGLT2 inhibitor prescription, by region?
definitions: SGLT2 inhibitor = ATC code starting with A10BK.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per region: patients with an active SGLT2 inhibitor.
